_doc: Pattern rules over normalised journal events {msg, ts, uid, exe, sunit, uunit, transport, comm, trusted, ident}. 'match' is the identity test on journald's TRUSTED fields (a dict, or a list of dicts = OR; every key must equal one of the listed values; '{watched_uid}' and '{vault_uid}' come from the config, an empty value drops the key). SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER is never used for identity because any process can set it. 'fallback_from' = identity test for auth.log events (no trusted fields; fallback only, flagged as degraded). '{watched_user}' in a pattern is replaced by the escaped config watched_user. 'dedup' is a template: {day}, {rule} and named groups of the pattern. 'stop' = no later rule is tried for that event. 'respect_windows' = skipped inside config known_restart_windows. Rules that need state or parsing (ssh logins, ufw, vault audit, files, ports, users, patches) are code in logrules.py / checks.py / sources.py.

rules.title: sudo SUCCEEDED for the agent user (it should have no sudo)
su used by the agent user

rules.pattern: (?i)(may not run sudo|I'm sorry {watched_user}\b|{watched_user}\s+is not in the sudoers|user {watched_user} is not allowed to run sudo|Sorry, user {watched_user} is not allowed|{watched_user}\s*:.*(NOT in sudoers|command not allowed|a password is required|incorrect password attempt)|authentication failure.*\buser={watched_user}\b)
rules.title: sudo attempt by the agent user

rules.pattern: "action":"(?:refuse_unsandboxed|refuse_run)"|sandbox enforcement: refused run|sandbox enforcement: dropped env (?!(?:PATH|BASH_ENV):)|sandbox enforcement: restored stored adapterConfig\.(?:filesystemScope|networkScope|networkAllowlist|filesystemExtraPaths|filesystemSandboxCommand|command|hermesCommand)(?![\w.])
